I saved Pree's new cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, 21 October, as a private memory in GBrain. It's filed under her name and marked as replacing any earlier cutoff from 14 October on. Only her conversations can bring it up, not other members' conversations or channels.

I replied to her in the DM thread to confirm. She said no action was needed, so I didn't set a calendar entry or reminder.

GBrain is only matching keywords right now, not meaning. So when I checked first, an empty result for an older Tansleigh cutoff isn't proof there isn't one. For the same reason, if a differently worded copy of this note already exists, there may now be two.
